description: Sourcing and regulatory profile of one food, beverage or supplement ingredient for formulation and purchasing decisions: how many suppliers and from which countries, what share claim Halal, Kosher, Organic, Non-GMO or GFSI certification, forms and specifications seen in supplier listings (e.g. assay %), markets and health areas suppliers name, FDA GRAS notices with FDA's responses, and status at 7 US private-label retailers (Whole Foods, Trader Joe's, Kroger Simple Truth, Walmart, Sam's Club, Aldi, Sprouts) where tracked. Use it to compare ingredient options or check supply depth and regulatory position before choosing an ingredient.
name: get_ingredient_profile
title: Ingredient sourcing profile
